- Parse the string once, using a counter for current open brackets and a flag indicating whether any nesting occurred; for each '[' increment count, for each ']' decrement if possible, otherwise ignore unmatched closing.
- Detect nesting by checking if when you see a '[', the current open count before increment is at least 1; if so, set the nesting flag true. Continue scanning to allow skipping unmatched parts and focusing on any valid nested subsequence.
- Return True if the nesting flag was set and there exists at least one matched pair overall (track matched pairs count by successful decrements); otherwise return False.
